scope: One case-owned Kind v1.36.1 cluster with Metadata-level kube-apiserver audit logging; three exact synthetic ConfigMap create operations; captured ResponseComplete audit JSONL archived as gzip JSONL in immutable ConfigMaps; and in-cluster Jobs that independently resolve an index target, verify the exact compressed-object SHA-256, decompress, parse, and select historical event IDs. Two independently scheduled Jobs retrieve the same primary record across a workload restart, while a distinct comparator retrieves a different record. This is a small local fixture, not evidence of production archive redundancy or policy compliance.

checks.claim: An unchecked readable index target returns the wrong historical audit event
Historical retrieval detects a wrong digest and an unavailable object
Distinct CronJob runs recover the same native history and the comparator resolves separately
